title: Reproducible Experiments
outcome: By the end, I can explain reproducible experiments using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Record variation across declared seeds instead of selecting the prettiest run.
given: Same fixed validation set of10 cases; declared runs seed 4=6 correct, seed 5=8, seed 6=7. All three are reported.
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Summarise variation
steps.detail: Mean accuracy is 70%; range is 60% to80%.

steps.label: Preserve context
steps.detail: Record data version, split, code, settings and seeds, not just the winning80%.

explanation: Read the picture in order. Record data version, split, code, settings and seeds, not just the winning80%. The arrows show which recorded input or intermediate result each decision uses. Explain the deciding step aloud before checking the changed case; pointing to the final answer alone does not show how it follows.

counterfactual.prediction: The remaining mean rises to75%, but the reported comparison becomes selectively incomplete.
counterfactual.reason: Removing an unfavourable declared run changes the evidence rather than improving the method.

student_task: What should accompany the mean 70%? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: The three individual run results, seed list, 60–80% range and shared evaluation conditions, so variability is visible. Changed-case check: The remaining mean rises to75%, but the reported comparison becomes selectively incomplete. Removing an unfavourable declared run changes the evidence rather than improving the method.
project_evidence: For your Responsible Plant Classifier, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: Seeds help reproduction but do not necessarily remove hardware or library nondeterminism; report the actual environment.
review_note: Reviewed Reproducible Experiments against the assigned lesson pack and its reserved independent case. Added a different explicit worked scenario, an auditable trace and a changed-input check; preserved the original curriculum and assessment boundary.
